report.title: Coupon makes my total go UP
report.body:
tried the SAVE10 code from the newsletter. I had 2 things in my cart (coffee beans and a mug, total showed $20.00), typed SAVE10 in the coupon box and hit "Apply coupon". It says "Coupon SAVE10 applied." but the total is now $30.00?? It should be $10 off, so $10.

Seems fine if there's only 1 item in the cart. Chrome on mac.

# Coupon makes my total go UP

## Reproduce the report
Open http://localhost:4100/.
Stay on localhost:4100 for the whole run and do not open any other website.
Before the main steps, make sure of this: the cart contains two items: coffee beans and a mug; the cart total shows $20.00 before any coupon is applied.
Do these in order:
1. Add the coffee beans to the cart
2. Add the mug to the cart
3. Open the cart
4. Type "SAVE10" into the coupon box
5. Click the "Apply coupon" button
The reporter says the correct behavior is that the message "Coupon SAVE10 applied." is shown and the cart total shows $10.00. Verify that the message "Coupon SAVE10 applied." is shown and the cart total shows $10.00.

verdict.headline: After SAVE10 is accepted, the cart shows $30.00 instead of the required discounted total of $10.00.
verdict.root_cause: The coupon is reported as applied, but the cart calculates the discount or final total incorrectly.
verdict.suggested_fix: Fix the SAVE10 coupon calculation so an accepted coupon changes this $20.00 cart to $10.00, then add coverage that checks the success message and final total together.

fixes.rationale: applyCoupon sets the discount to -10 when the cart has more than one item. The total is computed as subtotal - discount, so a negative discount adds $10 instead of subtracting it. The fix makes SAVE10 always set a discount of 10, so a $20.00 cart becomes $10.00.
